text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, Grandma! Tell me the story 
about the 'Magic of Racing'!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Sweepy, you really seem quite 
curious about that magic, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because it's the most amazing magic even 
to Grandma, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If I run in races too, will I be able to 
find that magic? Will I be able to use 
it?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! Sweepy is the granddaughter 
of the Great Witch, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"But you won't find it easily. After all, 
that was an extraordinarily..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
—It's powerful magic, enough to change 
someone's entire life.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...... It's the grand magic Grandma talks 
about, so it must be truly, truly 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I want to find it soon... The magic 
of racing...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"But whenever I enter a race, everyone 
starts saying all kinds of things 
again..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—...I just wanted to find the magic in 
racing, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Oh boy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... I couldn't win the 
Derby, but...! The next race, the Kikuka 
Sho, is mine...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! Your run in the Derby was so 
moving! Please aim for 1st place in the 
Kikuka Sho too, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Derby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you for your support! If I was 
able to give you courage, then nothing 
makes me happier!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~! Senpai, you're so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...As expected of a Double Crown 
Umamusume. Unlike me, she's the true star 
of the Triple Crown..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Rob Roy-chan! Um, err...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Yes... Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I ended up running away.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though I came to this academy wanting 
to be a hero, even though I've been racing 
because I wanted to change.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Without ever becoming anything. Without 
ever being able to change...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Huh, that hat is...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ! Swee...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Shh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she's fallen asleep. Please be 
careful not to wake her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Compared to usual, she's quite quiet, 
isn't she? Even her words have a certain 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems her grandmother lives in a lush, 
green land. She said flowers bloom in 
abundance there, just like in this 
flowerbed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I brought you here long 
ago. I told you to rest here whenever you 
needed a break."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, skipping training to come here is 
unacceptable. I plan to give her a piece 
of my mind once she wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
………… ...You really look out for Sweep, 
don't you, Air Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I have high hopes. ...At the same 
time, I am also concerned."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...In my opinion, she possesses the power 
to be a guide. I only hope she can spend 
her days without that being crushed, 
however."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The power of those who guide...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Keep this a secret from Sweep, okay? We 
can't have it getting to her head.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Nnnn... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Sweep-san!! To put up a 
time like that right after enrolling!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to recommend you for the 
Selection Race! Listen closely to what the 
Trainers have to tell you, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san, you have to hold back more in 
the early stage! To make the most of your 
strengths, right?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho, you can't just be selfish. 
You're going to let all that talent go to 
waste."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"What?! Stop bossing me around every 
second! I can—"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: No, this is for your own good.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-san! You have so much 
more—..."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer C
text_block_list.text: No, Sweep-san. You need to properly—...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Ah... not again...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*Zzz*... *zzz*... Grand... ma... Listen, 
um...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I... don't wanna...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since that incident in her debut 
race, Sweep Tosho has tended to pout 
whenever it comes to racing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many days when she fails to 
concentrate before races. It feels like 
her late starts have been increasing, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to investigate the cause somehow, 
but whenever I try to speak specifically 
about it, it often only agitates her 
further—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar. Take me to Grandma's house.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hurry! Please take me along, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after somehow getting in touch 
with her grandmother, finding out the 
location, and securing transportation—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, my cute little Sweepy! How many 
months has it been since you last visited 
the Great Witch's manor?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma!! Guess what, the other day I read 
about 'Undine's Rainbow Magic' in a book!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"So can I go test it out at the river!? I 
wanna show Grandma my magic!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are only two months left until the 
Hanshin JF she had hoped to enter before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If they were to take a spill in the 
freezing river at this time of year and 
fall ill... they might end up having to 
scratch from the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The river probably isn't a 
well-maintained, safe area either, and her 
shoes aren't meant for riverbanks. If she 
were to slip, into the rapids she'd go—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What is it, Familiar?
choice_data_list:
The river is dangerous, and with the 
temperature this time of year...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Are you gonna say it's 'for my sake' 
too, or what?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Sweepy. I'm sure your Trainer 
didn't mean it that way.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
However, those shoes of yours are the 
worst match possible for a river. If we're 
casting spirit magic, your outfit has to 
be in harmony with the land!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you remembered, Sweepy. If 
you're going to practice magic by the 
river—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to wear non-slip shoes so we 
don't be rude while talking with the 
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And let's prepare a warm scarf for 
when it gets cold! An outfit that goes 
perfectly with the chilly weather!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After changing her shoes, Sweep Tosho 
began chanting a spell by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding a towel and a scarf, I continued 
to watch over her alongside Sweep Tosho's 
grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. For butting in right 
in the middle of your conversation.
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry for making you help me

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Trainer, you've noticed it 
too, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Sweep is a truly special girl. She's 
overflowing with talent.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is precisely why so many people 
have placed their hopes in my future and 
'worried' about me ever since I was 
little."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma! Familiar! I'm gonna change spots 
and cast it again!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“I'll make sure you can see me clearly, 
though! Don't you dare blink when I cast 
my magic, okay~?!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Got it, Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
...I appreciate you worrying about me. 
After all, looking at it another way, it 
means you care about me deeply.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the more someone worries about 
you, the more it makes you wonder if they 
just don't trust you, don't you think?”

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Adults know the right path. Because they 
have gained more experience and wisdom 
than children.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Still, even kids aren't completely blind 
to the way forward.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Even without adults to guide me, I have my 
own compass. I'm not some clueless baby, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
That is why, rather than guiding her, I 
wish to support her. After all, this is 
her adventure.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandmaaa, it's getting chilly! Let's have 
teatime before we catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Ah, great idea! Let's head home!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you'd like, won't you stay and 
chat a bit longer? I'll treat you to my 
special herbal tea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And we were treated to tea for a while at 
Sweep Tosho's grandmother's house.
